patch_context.interpretation: Wowhead Live context confirms 12.1.5; Mythicstats does not explicitly label sample patch or hotfix timestamp. Do not infer all sampled logs are after a hotfix.

methodology.snapshot_policy: One retained HTTP snapshot per mode; preliminary connectivity requests are not pooled and no samples are added across fetches.
methodology.unit: Aggregated top combat logs; unique characters separately reported; not independent top-five players.
methodology.percent_unit: Original displayed percent; exact category denominator/unique-character weighting not disclosed. Slot percentages are marginal except explicitly labeled embellishment combinations.
methodology.windows: M+ last two weeks, raid last three weeks; absolute boundaries and hotfix cutoff unavailable.
methodology.scope: High-end observed usage, not causal ranking, guaranteed BiS, or proof of DPS improvement.
methodology.truncation: All rows exposed in requested categories retained; website may omit smaller shares.
methodology.tier_caution: Per-piece frequency is not a measured four-piece combination rate.
methodology.rounding: Percentages copied to one decimal; totals can differ from 100 by rounding or category slot multiplicity.

findings.observation: Farseer is the only displayed hero tree in both retained snapshots.
Janthrazet 271092 is dominant at 91.5% M+ / 83.2% raid; offhand 268196 leads at 57.5% / 44.3%. These are separate marginal frequencies, not a measured weapon pair.
Trinkets 270164 and 273796 lead at 84.4%/63.5% M+ and 81.9%/66.3% raid. Pair usage is not provided.
Crafted wrist 244584 leads the displayed Crafted list at 92.0% M+ / 81.9% raid. It does not prove the same embellishment is attached to that slot.
Two copies of Arcanoweave Lining effect 1283697 are the leading explicitly measured embellishment combination: 78.6% M+ / 83.4% raid.
